as_told.title: The curse of King Tut's tomb: the excavators die or meet tragedy
as_told.place_text: Tutankhamun's tomb, Valley of the Kings, Egypt

plain: This is the old story of a curse on the tomb of Tutankhamun, an ancient Egyptian king. The podcast host Jesse Michels says in 2024 that a couple of people tried to x-ray it and then died mysteriously. A researcher who goes by Luke Caverns tells it in 2025 as being about the dig led by the archaeologist Howard Carter. He says almost everyone on that excavation met with tragedy, and several died from poisoning after breathing the air inside the chamber. The story is told as a sign that something in the tomb was dangerous to those who disturbed it.
